commercial_product.summary: Medtronic markets a broad portfolio of approved medical devices across Cardiovascular, Medical Surgical, Neuroscience, and Diabetes operating segments.
examples: Resolute Onyx / Resolute Integrity drug-eluting coronary stents
HeartWare / HVAD historically (recall) and current cardiac rhythm devices
MiniMed 780G / 770G insulin pump systems with SmartGuard

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medtronic is a diversified medical device manufacturer; its R&D and clinical trials evaluate medical devices and device-drug combinations rather than proprietary new molecular entities. Per agent prompt, device pivotal/IDE trials are recorded in commercial_product context only, and no active P1/P2/P3 drug pipeline exists.
